name: pokeidle-community-sdk-workspace
description: Unofficial community SDK for building PokeIdle extensions. Not affiliated with or endorsed by PokeIdle.

scripts.build: npm run build -w pokeidle-community-sdk && npm run build -w pokeidle-test-extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w pokeidle-community-sdk && npm run typecheck -w pokeidle-test-extension
scripts.test: npm run test:sdk && npm run test:repo
